product.summary: Actively maintained Specter Desktop Bitcoin wallet GUI for hardware-wallet, multisig and Bitcoin Core/Electrum workflows.
product.notes: Support status is `supported` because the official repository contains current August 2026 wallet, dependency and security-related maintenance commits. This does not imply Specter normally holds the user's signing keys.
